# Value signals

Signals that show the work required judgment, not just execution. Pick the **2 or 3 strongest** per experience; more dilutes them.
Merge each signal into an existing bullet (action + how/why + outcome). Never add a standalone "value" bullet.

| Signal | What the reader should infer | Clues in the raw input | Phrasing patterns (EN / FR) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Need framing** | Understood the real user/business need before building | "pour la gestion de", "permettant de", "for users to", requests reworded | "…so that X could…" / "…pour que X puisse…" |
| **Design choice** | Chose an approach for a reason | "plutôt que", "instead of", configurable/generic components, choice of tool | "…as a configurable component rather than…" / "…sous forme de composant paramétrable…" |
| **Reuse / systemization** | Turned a one-off into something reusable or generic | "différents types", "templates", "réutilisable", several sites | "…reusable across sites" / "…réutilisable sur l'ensemble des sites" |
| **Automation** | Removed manual, repetitive or error-prone work | "automatisation", "script", "flux", "provisioning" | "…removing a manual step" / "…supprimant une tâche manuelle" |
| **Optimization** | Improved something existing instead of just adding | "amélioration", "optimisation", "refonte" | "Reworked…", "Streamlined…" / "Repensé…", "Fiabilisé…" |
| **User adoption** | Cared about end users, not just delivery | "accessibles aux utilisateurs", "personnalisables", training, feedback | "…letting each user tailor…" / "…que chacun peut personnaliser" |
| **Constraint handling** | Delivered within limits (legacy, security, time, governance) | "sans", "legacy", "contraintes", "sécurité", "gouvernance" | "…within the tenant's governance rules" / "…dans le respect de la gouvernance du tenant" |
| **Decision leadership** | Drove a design decision or shaped scope | "I opted", "I proposed", "I decided", clarified/arbitrated requests with the client | "Arbitrated…, settling the scope of…" / "Arbitré…, fixant le périmètre de…" |
| **Initiative** | Proposed something nobody asked for | "proposé", "à mon initiative", "suggested" | "Proposed and built…" / "Proposé puis développé…" |
| **Transfer** | Applied knowledge from another domain (see profile.md) | profile background, cross-tech work | "…applying X practices to Y" / "…en appliquant les pratiques X à Y" |
| **Impact** | Outcome for the client | numbers, before/after, adoption, time saved | "…cutting X" / "…réduisant X" |

## Reviewer lens (impact without measured numbers)

CV reviewers look for five things. Most experiences have no measured metrics; cover each area with what the source does support, never with estimates.

| Area | What to look for in the source | How to show it without metrics |
|---|---|---|
| **Quantification** | Countable facts: deliverables, deliveries, projects, items, flows, sites | State the count as given ("two WebParts", "second delivery"). Never estimate time saved or volumes. |
| **Scale** | Who and where: named user groups, entities, sites, regions, every occurrence of an event | Name the reach ("each site", "every status change", "the security team"). If only implied → inference to confirm. |
| **Decision leadership** | Choices the person made or influenced, ambiguities they resolved, scope they shaped | Phrase the decision and its reason through their input; never claim sole ownership of a team decision. |
| **Business outcome** | What was manual, risky, blocked or impossible before | State the operational before/after ("permissions now follow the item's status"), not the technical artifact ("created a flow"). |
| **AI as engineering** | Agent/LLM work | Frame as specification, steering, review, validation and integration of the output, not as "used AI". |

## Open questions to generate

When a signal is plausible but unproven, ask the user a targeted question instead of guessing:
- Impact: "How many users/sites? What changed after (time, tickets, errors)?" Ask only for what the user can count or recall now (sites, entities, user groups, deliveries); do not ask for measured metrics (time saved, % gains) unless the source hints they exist.
- Initiative: "Was this requested or your proposal?"
- Design choice: "What alternative did you rule out, and why?"
- Constraint: "Any constraint (legacy, security, deadline, governance) that made this harder?"
- Adoption: "Did users give feedback or adopt it widely?"
